title: Maternal anti-collapsin response mediator protein 1 antibody inducing autism-like behaviors in offspring.
abstract: Maternal anti-CRMP1 antibody persisted through gestation and was detected in offspring; exposed offspring showed delayed milestones and repetitive/stereotyped behaviors. Cortex transcriptomics on P30 showed downregulation of axon guidance and presynaptic membrane organization pathways; genes for presynaptic membrane organization (Nrxn1, Pten, Ptprd, Nlgn1) were significantly reduced. Anti-CRMP1 induced growth cone collapse in iPSC-derived immature neurons.
